messages:
emily: Heads-up 00: nightly billing_export skipped ~31 invoices from yesterday's window, reconciliation job alerted.

emily: Error in the export job log:
```
WARN export_job: skipping invoice inv_0Xabc - event_timestamp outside window (2026-03-23T00:10:02Z not in 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z..2026-03-22T23:59:59Z)
```

emily: Looks like the export window is using local TZ (PST) but incoming events are normalized to UTC; some late-night UTC invoices fall into previous day and are omitted from that day's file.

raj: That would break daily Stripe->NetSuite reconciliation. Is the NetSuite import job consuming the daily export file?

emily: Yes, ns_import consumes s3://redwood-billing/exports/daily/{date}.csv. Missing rows mean invoices never posted.

tom: Quick fix: expand the export window to 24h + 1h buffer (00:00:00Z..23:59:59Z + buffer) and add a dedupe key to importer so late items don't duplicate.

ops-jen: @billing-bot create ticket and flag for month-end priority.

billing-bot: Created FIN-5122: "Daily export window uses local TZ leading to skipped UTC invoices" assigned to @raj, priority P1, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5122

raj: Plan: (1) change export to always use UTC day boundaries and include a 2h safety buffer on either side, (2) add an invoice-level external_id check in importer, (3) generate a `backfill_candidates_{date}.csv` of invoices with event_ts within buffer so finance can review before import. ETA: 4hrs.

emily: Backfill candidates: 31 invoices found, I've copied them to s3://redwood-billing/backfills/2026-03-22/candidates.csv and paused NS import for that date.

tom: Also add a validation alert to the reconciliation job: if export row_count differs from Stripe daily invoice count by >1%, notify on #finance and create FIN-alarms.

ops-jen: SRE note: the lambda that writes export used the host tz for window calc after a daylight savings test. We'll pin to UTC in the runtime env.

raj: I'll include audit logs per invoice to s3://redwood-billing/audit/exports/{invoice_id}.json with 30d lifecycle and ensure ACLs are restricted.

emily: Finance asks that backfill CSV include customer_id, invoice_id, amount, event_ts, reason.

billing-bot: FIN-5122 updated: PR link https://git.redwood.ai/billing/commit/buffer-fix and backfill file attached.

emily: Thanks team. Please CC finance when backfill import runs. We'll need to include these in month-end reconciliation. :thumbsup:
